incidents.title: U.S.-Iran Ceasefire MOU — Signing Imminent (Deal Watch)
incidents.detail: MAJOR DEVELOPMENT: Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif — the primary mediator — declared Friday that a 'final, agreed-upon text' of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) has been prepared. Iranian FM Araghchi stated the deal 'has never been closer.' A Geneva signing ceremony is anticipated within days. Key deal elements (per U.S. officials): (1) Ceasefire across all fronts including Lebanon; (2) Strait of Hormuz reopening; (3) Lifting of U.S. naval blockade on Iran; (4) Iran commits to nuclear program dismantlement and uranium disposal (60-day negotiation period); (5) Iran stops funding proxy groups; (6) Staged sanction relief and $24B frozen asset release contingent on performance verification. COMPLICATING FACTORS: Iran disputes deal details publicly while negotiating privately. Trump accused Iran of leaking 'fake' terms. Trump calling Tehran 'very dishonourable.' ISW-CTP assess Iran is conducting information operations to maximize leverage. No deal is signed until it is signed. AUSTIN RELEVANCE: If deal is signed, Iranian diaspora community will react — both celebratory and protest factions possible. Iranian cyber retaliation risk declines significantly upon signing but not before. Maintain elevated cyber posture until signed and Strait reopens. Oil prices: Brent ~$85/bbl on deal optimism — monitor for travel logistics impacts if oil spikes on deal collapse.
